describe.description: The creature is a large quadrupedal mammal shown in right-facing profile on a plain light background. Its body, neck, head and limbs are covered in dense, shaggy fur that is dark brown on the back, sides, outer legs and top of the head, and lighter creamy-tan on the muzzle, lower cheek, chest and belly. The head is bear-like with a blunt snout, small dark eyes, and two small rounded ears on top. A single smooth, black, upward-curving horn projects from the tip of the snout. The entire dorsal surface from just behind the neck to over the hindquarters is covered by a large, highly glossy, dark reddish-brown domed shell with a reflective surface and faint horizontal ridging. The animal stands on four thick, fur-covered legs ending in broad paws with visible claws. No wings, gills, tentacles, or distinct tail are visible; the rear is obscured by fur and the overhanging edge of the shell.

describe.description: A large four-legged mammal shown in side view facing right. The body, head, legs and paws are covered in thick shaggy brown fur with a lighter tan muzzle and underbelly, like a bear. The head is bear-like with small rounded ears on top and dark eyes on the sides. A single long curved black horn projects upward from the tip of the nose. The entire back from behind the neck to the rump is covered by a large glossy dark-brown domed shell in two main sections with fine lengthwise lines and a segmented rim around the lower edge. The legs are thick and columnar and end in broad flat paws with long pale claws. No wings or distinct tail are visible.
